description: This file contains JavaScript functions for styling and layout manipulation within a TinyMCE plugin, including default style parameters, style application, and UI control setup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes style settings and UI controls for the TinyMCE style plugin.

methods.name: setupFormData
methods.description: Populates form fields with current style values from the container element.

methods.name: generateCSS
methods.description: Generates and applies CSS styles to the container element based on form inputs.

methods.name: applyAction
methods.description: Applies the current style settings to the container element.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Applies style changes and closes the popup.

methods.name: showDisabledControls
methods.description: Updates UI controls to reflect disabled state.

methods.name: fillSelect
methods.description: Populates select elements with style options based on parameters.

methods.name: toggleSame
methods.description: Toggles input fields for style properties that can be uniform or individual.

methods.name: synch
methods.description: Synchronizes values between two form fields.
